subject: Walkling Court Redevelopment
overview: The Community Development Board approved the site plan review for the Medford Housing Authority's Walkling Court redevelopment project and voted to recommend City Council approval of the planned development special permit.

items.title: Walkling Court Site Plan Review and Special Permit Recommendation
items.summary: The board approved the site plan review with conditions and recommended City Council approval of the planned development special permit for the Medford Housing Authority's 238-unit affordable redevelopment, including a $50,000 contribution toward a city tree fund.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from December 20, 2023, and December 6, 2023.

items.title: Staff and Board Updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on retaining zoning consultant Emily Innes, scheduling upcoming council zoning subcommittee working sessions, and welcoming new department personnel.
